changes_made.description: Added validate_file_path import and applied it to each path returned by git log output, silently skipping paths that fail validation (path traversal prevention)
Scoped BufReader in a block so it is dropped (closing the stdout pipe) before calling child.wait(), preventing potential pipe hang
Sanitized the 'since' value in stderr output using strip_control_chars() to prevent control character injection in terminal output

warnings_addressed.description: git log output paths now validated with validate_file_path (path traversal prevention)
warnings_addressed.resolution: Paths containing '..', absolute paths, null bytes, backslashes, or exceeding 1024 chars are silently skipped

warnings_addressed.description: BufReader dropped before child.wait() to prevent pipe hang
warnings_addressed.resolution: Wrapped BufReader usage in a block scope so it is dropped before wait()
Applied strip_control_chars() to sanitize the since value before printing to stderr

warnings_deferred.reason: run_changed_since_search already uses current_dir() for repo_path. Path::new('.') is used consistently elsewhere for index/symbol paths and changing it would be a larger refactor beyond the scope of this issue

warnings_deferred.description: 4-char hex strings misidentified as commit hashes
warnings_deferred.reason: The validate_commit_hash function (min 4 chars) is defined in git_info.rs and shared across the codebase. Changing the minimum would affect other callers. The practical risk is low since git itself will error on ambiguous short hashes
Already has explicit eprintln warning when truncation occurs (search.rs lines 855-859). Not silent
